item.title: エヌビディア時価総額、2日間で4700億ドル超消失も ＣＥＯ不倫騒動で
item.description: [１０日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア 株が１０日の取引で続落した。同社のジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディア時価総額、2日間で4700億ドル超消失も　ＣＥＯ不倫騒動で 2:39 配信

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯ。9月15日、サンフランシスコで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria（ロイター） [１０日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア 株が１０日の取引で続落した。同社のジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と中国政府に情報を渡していたとされる中国人女性との不倫騒動の影響への懸念が高まる中、エヌビディアの時価総額は２営業日で４７００億ドル超消失する見通しとなった。

エヌビディア株は９日に４．３％下落。１０日も午後までに６％超下落している。

エヌビディアの下落によって、マイクロソフトがエヌビディアを抜き、２０２５年６月以来初めて、時価総額世界２位に浮上した。

米ニュースサイトのジ・インフォメーションは同日、関係筋の情報として、フアンＣＥＯと中国人女性との不倫関係が、少なくとも７５億ドル相当の同社製半導体の中国企業への出荷を後押ししたと報じた。ファン氏と関係があったアリス・フアン氏は夫や姉妹とともに、エヌビディア製半導体を調達するため、中国とシンガポールに企業網を構築したという。

バンク・オブ・アメリカのアナリストは「投資家の間で議論されているのは、これが同社固有の問題にとどまるのか、それとも人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ全体の混乱につながるかという点だ」と指摘。同時に「われわれは、疑惑と実証された事業上の損害を同一視するつもりはない」とした。

エヌビディアはこれまでに、フアンＣＥＯが外国の情報活動の標的となっていたかどうかを調査すると発表。フアン氏は従業員向けのメッセージで、妻に対して不貞行為を働いたことを認め、自らの行動について「全責任」を負うと表明。エヌビディアは、同氏が引き続き同社の経営を担う決意を示していると説明している。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：「永久先物」に揺れる米金融街、新たなリスク警戒　政権が導入推進 アングル：正念場のバングラ衣料産業　賃上げ圧力で競争力低下懸念、供給も混乱 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/11(水) 2:39 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Bonos del Tesoro caen y rendimientos a dos años registran su mayor alza diaria desde abril de 2025
item.description: Los rendimientos de los bonos a dos años subieron hasta 18 puntos básicos, su mayor avance diario desde abril de 2025, mientras los operadores elevaron sus apuestas por nuevas alzas de tasas.
item.dc:creator: Michael MacKenzie
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los bonos del Tesoro cayeron y los operadores reforzaron sus apuestas de que los responsables de la Reserva Federal subirán las tasas de interés en su próxima reunión de diciembre, tras los indicios de que la inflación en Estados Unidos se mantiene elevada. Estas caídas provocaron que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a dos años —que son más sensibles a la trayectoria de la Fed que los de mayor vencimiento— subieran hasta 18 puntos básicos, hasta situarse en el 4,74% el martes, lo que supone la mayor variación en un solo día desde abril de 2025. Los operadores reforzaron sus apuestas por al menos dos subidas de tasas para mediados de 2027 y comenzaron a descontar una pequeña probabilidad de que se produzca una subida excepcional de medio punto en diciembre. Ver más: Inflación subyacente de EE.UU. sube 0,3% en octubre y refuerza expectativas de alza de tasas Anteriormente, ya habían descontado por completo las expectativas de una subida de un cuarto de punto en diciembre, después de que el gobernador de la Fed, Christopher Waller, declarara en Londres que apoyaba una subida de las tasas y que estaría a favor de una subida de medio punto si la inflación continuaba acelerándose. “Es evidente que la subida de 50 puntos básicos está sobre la mesa”, afirmó Tiffany Wilding, economista de Pacific Investment Management Co., en Bloomberg TV. El índice de precios al consumo, excluidos los alimentos y la energía, subió un 0,3% con respecto al mes anterior, según datos de la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales (BLS). Los precios en general subieron un 0,4%. La Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales (BLS) no publicó las variaciones interanuales, ya que la recopilación de datos se interrumpió el pasado mes de octubre durante el cierre del Gobierno. Estos datos se producen tras los datos del mercado laboral publicados el viernes, que pusieron de relieve unas sólidas tendencias de contratación y un aumento inesperado en el crecimiento salarial. Los operadores consideraron que ambos informes respaldaban una subida de las tasas de interés estadounidenses, después de que los responsables de la política monetaria optaran por un aumento de un cuarto de punto en septiembre y mantuvieran las tasas sin cambios en octubre. Ver más: Waller, de la Fed, abre la puerta a una posible subida de tasas de medio punto en diciembre El rendimiento de los bonos a 10 años subió diez puntos básicos, hasta el 4,98%, antes de la subasta del Tesoro de una nueva emisión por valor de US$42.000 millones, prevista para las 13:00 horas, hora de Nueva York. “La Fed se saltó octubre y ahora probablemente tendrá que recuperar terreno”, afirmó Alex Pelle, economista sénior para EE.UU. de Mizuho. “El debate girará probablemente en torno a 25 frente a 50 puntos básicos en la reunión de diciembre, no entre cero y 25″. Las declaraciones de Waller en un discurso pronunciado en Londres antes de que se conocieran los datos de EE.UU. habían dado a los mercados un anticipo de lo que se avecinaba. Señaló la posibilidad de un informe favorable —concretamente, uno que mostrara una inflación del IPC subyacente en torno al 0,3 ¿% o superior— como motivo por el que consideraba que debería barajarse una subida de 50 puntos básicos en diciembre. Esas indicaciones llevaron a los inversores a elevar los rendimientos a corto plazo unos cinco puntos básicos al inicio de la sesión, antes de la publicación de los datos. Ver más: Wall Street cae junto a los bonos del Tesoro tras dato de inflación que presiona a la Fed Waller da el pistoletazo de salida a una intensa ronda de discursos de otros responsables de la Fed esta semana, entre los que se incluyen el del nuevo presidente de la Fed, John Williams, el jueves, y el del vicepresidente, Philip Jefferson, el viernes. Los operadores analizarán minuciosamente esas intervenciones en busca de más indicaciones sobre la trayectoria de la Fed, a pesar de que el presidente Kevin Warsh haya afirmado en repetidas ocasiones que el banco central no debería ofrecer ese tipo de información. “A estas alturas, parece que diciembre es una opción viable”, afirmó Eric Souza, gestor senior de carteras de Capital Advisors Group Inc. “Será interesante ver si Williams y/o Jefferson se pronuncian en los próximos días e intentan rebatir el comentario de Waller sobre los 50 puntos básicos”. Los operadores descontaban en el mercado de swaps un endurecimiento total de 29 puntos básicos para la reunión de diciembre, lo que implica apenas un 16% de probabilidades de que los responsables opten por una medida de mayor envergadura. “El informe de inflación de hoy es una señal de advertencia”, afirmó Seema Shah, estratega global jefe de Principal Asset Management. “El mensaje para la Fed es incómodo, pero claro: la lucha contra la inflación no ha terminado”. Ver más: Una guía para invertir tras resultados de elecciones en EE.UU.: acciones, bonos, dólar y oro Afirmó que la Fed “aún no ha llegado a ese punto” en lo que respecta a una subida excepcional el próximo mes, ya que “una medida de gran envergadura debería requerir pruebas de que la inflación se está acelerando de forma decisiva, de que las expectativas se están desanclando o de que la economía se está sobrecalentando”. A medida que se disparaban los rendimientos a corto plazo y se reforzaban las expectativas de un mayor endurecimiento por parte de la Fed, el dólar subió casi un 0,5% el martes. Para Alex Cohen, estratega del Bank of America, el informe del IPC y los recientes datos de empleo ofrecían un potencial alcista para el dólar, aunque este sigue siendo vulnerable a los precios del petróleo y a la incertidumbre en torno a la inteligencia artificial. Los bonos del Estado estadounidense han recuperado parte de las pérdidas registradas este año, vinculadas a la preocupación de que la guerra en Irán y los elevados costos energéticos mantuvieran la inflación en niveles elevados. Tras registrar máximos de varias décadas a principios de octubre, el mercado se ha beneficiado de su reputación como valor refugio. Ver más: Wall Street se prepara para la mayor reforma de las ventas de bonos del Tesoro en años La victoria arrolladora de los demócratas en las elecciones de mitad de legislatura intensificó la inquietud en torno a la sostenibilidad del gasto en infraestructuras de inteligencia artificial, lo que provocó una ola de ventas en el mercado bursátil y una huida hacia activos seguros. “El sector tecnológico de la IA tiene que estabilizarse y, una vez que eso ocurra, se podrá argumentar con mucha solidez que esta caída de los rendimientos de 50 puntos básicos durante el último mes se debió, en realidad, únicamente a la demanda de activos refugio”, afirmó Kevin Flanagan, director de estrategia de inversión de WisdomTree. “Si se analiza lo ocurrido en cuanto a los datos económicos, todo apunta a que podríamos asistir a un repunte de los rendimientos —y tal vez a un retorno al 5% en el caso del bono a 10 años”. -Con la colaboración de Edward Bolingbroke, Greg Ritchie, Victor Swezey y Anya Andrianova. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Defiant Hegseth blasts impeachment effort ahead of House vote
item.description: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth also thanked US President Donald Trump for his support as lawmakers prepared to vote on eight articles of impeachment against him.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Defiant Hegseth blasts impeachment effort ahead of House vote

US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth also thanked US President Donald Trump for his support as lawmakers prepared to vote on eight articles of impeachment against him.

US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth holds a press briefing at the Pentagon in Washington, DC, US, November 10, 2026. REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein

11 Nov 2026 01:32AM

FAST

WASHINGTON: Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday (Nov 10) blasted efforts to impeach him as a farce that would embolden US adversaries, as he lashed out at his political opponents in Congress and the media in an unapologetic defence of his record. Striking a defiant tone at a Pentagon news briefing, Hegseth thanked US President Donald Trump for his continued support as the House of Representatives scheduled a procedural vote for late Tuesday that will test support for his impeachment. Hegseth said past impeachments of Trump had ultimately failed, and added: "Both times he came back stronger, and the American people sent him back to the White House. Now they're trying a third time. This time against a member of his cabinet."

US Representative Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican, introduced eight articles of impeachment against H egseth on Monday. Massie said in a post on X that if the House of Representatives can overcome Tuesday's procedural effort, "we will proceed to a real debate and vote on the Articles of Impeachment." Congressional sources say the resolution may have the votes to pass even with Trump’s Republicans still controlling the House until Democrats take over on Jan 3. Conviction appears unlikely in the Senate, however, where a two-thirds majority is required and Republicans hold 53 of 100 seats. Hegseth is accused of various abuses of power in office, including issuing orders to go to war with Iran without an imminent threat or approval from Congress. Voter anger over the Iran war helped Democrats win control of Congress in last week's midterm elections . A new Reuters/Ipsos poll published on Tuesday found a majority of Americans want the newly elected Democratic-majority US Congress to act to end the war with Iran.

US Representative Thomas Massie (R-KY) holds a press conference about his resolution to impeach Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth, on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC, US, Nov 9, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein)

Vice President JD Vance has publicly questioned the war. Hegseth declined to be drawn into responding to Vance, but defended the conflict, calling Trump courageous and saying Iran's military has been left in ruins. "History will judge the Iran war quite differently than the conventional wisdom right now," he said. Hegseth cited US Secretary of State Marco Rubio as saying of the war: "It's not necessarily popular, but it may have been necessary, and that's certainly how I feel. It was a necessary undertaking." Trump repeated his backing of Hegseth in a post on his Truth Social platform just after the Pentagon briefing ended. "Pete Hegseth gets an 'A' PLUS, PLUS, PLUS for his defense against a disgruntled, angry, defeated, former Congressman, Thomas Massie, a TOTAL LOSER!" he wrote. A polarizing figure in American politics, Hegseth would be the first US defense secretary to be impeached. The last time any civilian leader of the US military was impeached was in 1876, when William Belknap held the title "secretary of war." Hegseth, a former Fox News host, calls himself secretary of war, part of his effort to rebrand a military he said was too weak and "woke" when he took office last year. But even some Republicans say his strained relations with Congress are becoming a political liability as the administration seeks a US$1.5 trillion defense spending package. In a possible nod to the spending requests, Hegseth said Republicans should use their final weeks in control of Congress to deliver wins for the American people instead of pursuing his impeachment. If he's still around next year, Democrats have promised to investigate Hegseth and his handling of the Pentagon, including his firing of the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and other top military officers.

Related:

Trump vows comeback as bitter showdown with Congress looms

Trump says Hegseth doing 'a very good job' as questions swirl about his future

Source: Reuters/fs

Nov 10 : Anthropic said on Tuesday it was bringing its Claude assistant to video conference platform Google Meet, as the company pushes to integrate AI deeper into everyday office work. Earlier in the day, Anthropic launched a roadshow for its highly anticipated US initial public offering, with plans to raise as much as $64.4 billion at a $1.02 trillion valuation. The offering will test investors' appetite for the AI boom and Anthropic's massive spending plans. Called Claude Meetings, the new feature will let users add Claude to video calls as a visible participant. Anthropic said Claude would be able to follow the conversation and turn discussions into work in real time, while also drafting plans, creating timelines and answering questions in the call's chat. The feature is designed to shift AI's role in meetings from simply recording or summarizing conversations to doing the work that follows from them while the discussion is still taking place, Anthropic said.

Claude Meetings is launching in beta for Anthropic's Team and Enterprise customers initially through Google Meet, although the company plans to expand it to other meeting platforms. The rollout is part of a broader push by Anthropic to make Claude an active participant in knowledge work. The company said it was also introducing Claude Whiteboards, which lets teams turn discussions into timelines and action plans, as well as Claude Sheets and Claude Data.

item.title: 米国との交渉行われず、継続主張は虚偽＝イラン最高安保委トップ
item.description: [１０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１０日 ロイター] - イランの国防・外交を統括する最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長は１０日、イランと米国との間で現在、いかなる交渉も行われていないと述べた。親イラン系放送局アルマヤディーンのインタビューで述べた。

レザイ氏は、イランは米国に提示した条件に対する明確な回答を求めているとし、米国は現時点で明確な回答を示していないものの、将来的に回答する可能性があると指摘。一方、イランとの交渉が継続しているとの米国の主張については「全くの虚偽で、ねつ造だ」と語った。

また、イランが提示した７つの条件を米国が満たさない限り、ホルムズ海峡は開放されないと改めて表明した。

これに先立ち、イランのアラグチ外相は、レザイ氏とバンス米副大統領との会談を巡る報道について「根拠のないメディアの憶測」として否定していた。

item.title: Chennai Petroleum Corp to M&M: Brokerages' Diwali picks for Samvat 2083
item.description: November rally has brought a festive glow to equities. Brokerages identify their potential winners for Samvat 2083 ...
item.dc:creator: Krishna Kant, Ram Prasad Sahu
item.content:encoded:
Home / Markets / News / Tata Steel to Hindalco: Brokerages' Diwali picks for Samvat 2083

Tata Steel to Hindalco: Brokerages' Diwali picks for Samvat 2083 November rally has brought a festive glow to equities. Brokerages identify their potential winners for Samvat 2083 premium

Illustration: Binay Sinha

Krishna Kant Ram Prasad Sahu Mumbai 10 min read Last Updated : Nov 10 2026 | 11:21 PM IST

Listen to This Article

A surprise rally on Dalal Street last week lifted the benchmark BSE Sensex 9 per cent month to date in November, restoring optimism after a weak start to 2026.

The index fell nearly 15 per cent between January and September and lost 4 per cent during Samvat 2082 (October 20, 2025, to November 6, 2026), its worst Samvat performance since 2014. By comparison, the index gained 6.3 per cent during Samvat 2081. The latest rally, driven by foreign portfolio investor (FPI) buying, has turned brokerages bullish on Samvat 2083.

Brokerage estimates suggest the benchmark could gain nearly 14 per cent over the

next year, supported by continued FPI buying and earnings growth. The Sensex has delivered a compound annual growth rate of 9.66 per cent over the past 12 Samvat years, from October 22, 2014, to November 6, 2026.

Brokerages expect the Sensex to reach 92,170 by November 6, 2027, against 81,028 at the close of Samvat 2082 on November 6, 2026.

The index’s underlying earnings per share is forecast to rise 13 per cent over the next 12 months, to around ₹4,440 from ₹3,933 on November 9, 2026, based on Bloomberg’s blended one-year forward estimate. This would exceed the 7.3 per cent growth recorded over the previous 12 months. The projections imply a one-year forward price-to-earnings (P/E) multiple of 20.8x for the Sensex in November 2027, marginally above its current trailing P/E of 20.6x.

Brokerages’ 2026 Diwali picks suggest that several stocks could outperform the benchmark, driven by earnings growth and valuation rerating. Analysts see continued bullishness in industrial metals and energy prices, while expecting capital expenditure-led growth to benefit sectors such as capital goods, engineering, and construction. They also expect credit growth to remain firm, supporting earnings and share prices of fast-growing banks and other lenders.

Here are 10 stocks that could shine in Samvat 2083.

Tata Steel

The stock of steel major Tata Steel barely moved over a one-year period though the potential upside from these levels is a healthy 17.9 per cent

In Q2FY27, the Tata group firm’s operating performance was in line with strong India earnings offset by persistent weakness in the Europe business

An increasing focus on downstream expansion and strategic sales of surplus iron ore should aid domestic margins in the medium term

In the Netherlands, unresolved regulatory resolutions continue to cloud visibility on decarbonisation investments

Motilal Oswal Research expects operating profit improvement for Europe’s operations in the coming quarters on account of improving prices, along with regulatory measures (carbon border adjustment mechanism/reduction in import quotas) and improving operational efficiency

FY28 earnings growth, according to Emkay Research, is likely to accelerate on capacity ramp-up and improved operating leverage

Coal India

Coal India reported a healthy Q2FY27 performance, with revenue growing 20.9 per cent, supported by 12.9 per cent growth in offtake and a 6.4 per cent improvement in blended realisation

India’s largest coal miner, according to Elara Securities, has multiple long-term tailwinds including rising acceptance of coal as a dominant fuel mix and good volume delivery in

the past few quarters, along with better evacuation infrastructure in terms of first-mile connectivity projects

Its diversification strategy is another positive as the company is going beyond its core coal business, with progress across renewable energy and critical minerals

A healthy balance sheet and a likely annual dividend payout of ₹26-27 per share with a 6 per cent yield are other triggers

Axis Bank

Brokerages are bullish on Axis Bank as they expect the lender to outperform its peers in terms of loan and deposit growth

The stock has 49 “buy” and 3 “sell” recommendations from brokerages. Axis Bank sits firmly in the upper tier of largecap bank stocks

Brokerages expect the stock to deliver 20 per cent upside from current level compared to 7.4 per cent rise in the last 12 months

The bank’s adjusted net profit was up 37.6 per cent Y-o-Y while gross interest income was up 17.6 per cent Y-o-Y in Q2FY27

According to Motilal Oswal Securities (MOSL), loan book was up 23 per cent Y-o-Y led by the corporate and SME segments

The bank’s deposits were up 21 per cent Y-o-Y aided by FCNR (B) deposits while low-cost Casa deposits’ share was stable at 36 per cent according to MOSL

Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers

Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers is a defence shipbuilding major with strong execution across complex naval platforms and a growing order pipeline. The stock was down 14.6 per cent over the past year but offers a healthy upside of 26.5 per cent

In Q1, the firm surprised positively on both sales and profitability, likely due to faster execution for P17A and anti-submarine shallow water crafts, points out Elara Securities. Q2 results are scheduled for November 11

The recent trigger for the stock was the order earlier this month for the construction of five Next Generation Corvettes (NGCs)’ with the Indian Navy at a total value of ₹32,000 crore

The management expects an order pipeline of ₹1.5 trillion in defence in the upcoming 12-18 months, led by large tenders of P17B (next generation stealth frigates) worth ₹70,000 crore, landing platform docks of ₹35,000 crore, mine counter­measure vessels of ₹32,000 crore and smaller tenders

Hindalco Industries

A fully integrated aluminium producer, Hindalco Industries is one of the top Diwali picks in the largecap space thanks to a continued bullishness in base metal prices

There are 19 “buy” and 10 “sell” recommendations on the stock and brokerages expect a further 21.5 per cent upside in its stock price from the current level, buil­ding on a similar return last year

The consolidated adjusted net profit of Aditya Birla group's metals flagship firm was up 50.4 per cent Y-o-Y while its net sales were up 38.8 per cent Y-o-Y in Q2FY27, driven by a 23 per cent Y-o-Y rise in aluminium realisations and broad-based volume growth

According to Axis Securities, Hindalco's aluminium dispatches were up 3 per cent Y-o-Y and 6 per cent Q-o-Q in Q2FY27 while copper shipments were up 3 per cent Y-o-Y and 10 per cent Y-o-Y in the quarter

The firm’s upstream Aluminium business’ Ebitda per tonne was up 40 per cent Y-o-Y in USD while the copper segment Ebitda surged 164 per cent Y-o-Y to a record high level in Q2FY27, according to Axis Securities

Ujjivan Small Finance Bank

Ujjivan Small Finance Bank  is also on brokerage’s radar this Diwali as the lender continues to deliver double-digit growth in revenues and profits

The lender’s gross interest income was up 28 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) in Q2FY27 while its adjusted net profit was up 200 per cent Y-o-Y in the quarter

Brokerages expect the bank to continue its growth momentum and all 21 brokerages tracking it have a “buy” call with no “hold” or “sell” recommendations

According to Axis Securities, Ujjivan's disbursement momentum remained healthy, growing by 33 per cent Y-o-Y in Q2FY27 and up 14 per cent Q-o-Q led by a strong momentum in the non-Microfinance segment

Its net interest income (NII) was up 35 per cent Y-o-Y in Q2FY27 owing to better growth in the microfinance segment and lower interest reversals, while the net interest margin was 8.4 per cent compared to 8.5 per cent in Q1FY27

Aptus Value Housing Finance

With a 39.8 per cent fall, Aptus is the worst-performing stock in this list. Conversely, it also offers the highest potential upside at 73.7 per cent

In Q2, the home loan financier’s assets under management (AUM) saw a growth of 20.5 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) and this was powered by healthy disbursements

Spreads remained resilient at 8.9 per cent though asset quality was soft, particularly in NBFC. The management is strengthening NBFC underwriting, collections, and legal recovery, and expects asset quality to normalise by FY27-end, while raising FY27 credit-cost guidance by 5-10 basis points

Choice Institutional Equities expects Aptus to deliver AUM and net interest income or NII annual growth of 21.5 per cent and 17.9 per cent, respectively, during FY26-28, supported by a sustained disbursement momentum and a healthy spread profile

Mahindra & Mahindra

The outlook for Mahindra & Mahindra’s (M&M’s) two key segments of auto and tractors offers divergent trends. While demand trends in the underlying auto industry continue to remain robust, tractors are likely to see muted traction owing to rainfall deficit and drought conditions in key regions

In the auto segment, ICICI Securities expects M&M’s healthy performance to continue, supported by strong traction for its models, capacity addition in the near term and new launches

Nearly half a dozen launches are expected in M&M’s passenger vehicle division over the next few months

The company reduced FY27 tractor industry growth guidance from 5 per cent to flat. This translates to a double-digit decline in H2FY27 and is weighed down by demand dip in Maharashtra and Karnataka

According to Systematix Research, the company offers healthy medium-term growth visibility, underpinned by its strong SUV franchise, expanding EV portfolio, capacity additions and improving earnings diversification

Chennai Petroleum Corp

An oil refining subsidiary of Indian Oil Corporation, CPCL gained handsomely from a cut in excise duty on diesel and petrol in March this year and a rise in refining margins on transport fuels due to the West Asia conflict

The firm’s adjusted net profit more than tripled in Q2FY27 on a year-on-year (Y-o-Y) basis, marking its fifth consecutive quarter of high double-digit earnings growth

CPCL’s excise duty payout in Q2FY27 was down 60 per cent Y-o-Y, the lowest in 47 quarters. Meanwhile, net sales were up 26 per cent Y-o-Y and profit before interest, depreciation, and taxes (PBIDT) increased by 177 per cent Y-o-Y

Brokerages expect refining margins and PBIDT margins to stay firm in the forthcoming quarter as the US-Iran conflict continues to simmer Bull case for CPCL also gets support from its low

valuation, with a trailing price-to-earnings multiple of 3.8x and a price-to-book value of 1.9

Genus Power Infrastructures

The Street expects 57 per cent upside in Genus Power’s  stock over the next 12 months from the current levels driven by a continued traction in its earnings growth

The company’s adjusted net profit was up 43.2 per cent while its net sales were up 44.8 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) in Q2FY27

Brokerages expects earnings growth to stay strong driven by expansion in renewal power generation and roll out of smart metering by power distribution companies

The company reported an executable order book of ₹24,020 crore as of June 30, 2026, worth more than 5x its net sales in FY26 according to ICICI Direct

The stock is currently trading at a trailing price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 13.4x and a price-to-book value of 3.9

The company’s high net working capital equivalent to nearly 11-month worth of company’s net sales in FY26, could severely strain its balance sheet

Topics : stock market trading Diwali stocks

FAST

Nov 10 : IBM said on Tuesday that it was ending US visa and green card sponsorship for a majority of roles in IBM Consulting, which employs more than 150,000 people. The move comes amid tight scrutiny of foreign tech hiring by Donald Trump's administration. Last month, it suspended Microsoft, Adobe and several major outsourcers, including Cognizant, Infosys and Tata Consultancy Services, from the Permanent Labor Certification process — a key step toward green cards for foreign workers. IBM Consulting has used US high-skilled visa programs to address skill shortages, but participation has been declining for years, a company spokesperson told Reuters. It opted to end sponsorship for most such roles as skill availability and client needs have evolved, the spokesperson added.

Google agrees to additional privacy protections in Spirit Airlines data sale

FILE PHOTO: The Google logo is displayed during a press conference in Berlin, Germany, November 11, 2025. REUTERS/Lisi Niesner/File Photo

FILE PHOTO: A Spirit Airlines aircraft sits at Miami International Airport in Florida, U.S., May 2, 2026. REUTERS/Nathan Howard/FIle Photo

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 10 : Alphabet's Google has agreed to additional privacy protections in the acquisition of employee data from defunct Spirit Airlines, a union representing employees said Tuesday. The agreement clears the way next week for approval of Google's $10 million deal to acquire Spirit data to train AI models. The union said it had won a more rigorous de-identification process than previously planned and added significant employee data will be excluded from the sale, including health and medical information. As part of Spirit's closure and asset liquidation, Google won an auction in August for data from emails, spreadsheets and calendars, as well as for marketing, productivity and operations. Spirit Airlines halted operations in May. A bankruptcy judge is now set to approve the deal next week.

The Association of Flight Attendants-CWA said the de-identified data will also be reviewed by an independent verification agent chosen in consultation with unions, and Google is prohibited from attempting to re-identify the data and is required to process it in a secure environment and treat it as confidential. A group of about 120 lawmakers raised concerns last month about the data sale. Last month, a privacy ombudsman recommended a US bankruptcy judge approve the deal after excluding passenger personal information from 97 million Spirit customers. The lawmakers, led by Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Massachusetts Democrat, and Representative Steven Horsford, a Nevada Democrat, said the sale would include 100 million emails, 500 million Microsoft Teams messages and other employee records. Spirit Airlines said it was pleased to have reached a resolution with labor unions as it continueed to maximize value for its creditors. "We are grateful for the collaboration of Google, the consumer privacy ombudsman, our labor unions, and other key stakeholders who are engaging with us constructively on this sale," a spokesperson said. Google, which did not immediately comment Tuesday, said last month it did not want to acquire personal information. "We are not looking to buy any personal information from Spirit. The information will either be completely excluded or will be de-identified by an independent third party before Google receives any data," Google said last month.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米追加利上げ、少なくとも2回必要 迅速な対応も＝ダラス連銀総裁
item.description:
Ann Saphir
[１０日 ロイター] - 米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁は１０日、インフレを抑制するにはＦＲＢ（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米追加利上げ、少なくとも2回必要　迅速な対応も＝ダラス連銀総裁 1:25 配信

2026年1月13日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）。REUTERS/Nathan Howard（ロイター） Ann Saphir

[１０日 ロイター] - 米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁は１０日、インフレを抑制するにはＦＲＢ（連邦準備理事会）が少なくともあと２回、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施する必要があるとし、幅広い物価上昇圧力が経済に定着するのを防ぐため、速やかに行動する必要があるかもしれないとの考えを示した。

ローガン総裁はダラス連銀とカンザスシティー連銀が共催するエネルギー会議に向けて準備した講演原稿で、「現在の見通しを踏まえると、ＦＯＭＣ（連邦公開市場委員会）が少なくともあと２回、２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施する必要があることは依然として明確だ」と指摘。「過度なインフレは容認できない」と述べた。

米労働省が１０日発表した１０月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）によると、変動の大きい食品とエネルギーを除くコアＣＰＩは前月比０．３％上昇した。このペースが続けば、前年比で４％を超えるインフレ率に相当する。ＦＲＢは個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数で測定するインフレ率について２％の目標を掲げている。

ローガン総裁は「利上げの正確なペースは、短期的な経済・金融環境次第だ。ＦＯＭＣがこの秋これまで動いてきたよりも、この冬はより速いペースで動くことが可能かもしれない」とした。

その上で、インフレが上昇しているのは、戦時のエネルギー供給の混乱や関税だけが原因ではなく、最近のショックが収束した後も続き得る、より広範な傾向も背景にあると指摘。「インフレと雇用を巡る見通しとリスクを適切にバランスさせるには、より引き締め的な政策が必要になる。そして、そのバランスを速やかに達成することが重要だ。目標を上回るインフレが長く続くほど、それが行動に定着するリスクが高まる」と語った。

ＦＲＢの次回の金融政策決定会合は１２月８─９日に開かれる。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：預金から国債へ、「金利ある世界」で個人の動き活発　警戒する銀行 コラム：2027年は円高に転じるか、日銀の利上げ継続と円相場の行方＝内田稔氏 アングル：日銀、基調物価2％定着へ利上げ継続　「次の次」は転換点か コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も 11/11(水) 1:25 最終更新 ロイター

PARIS, Nov 10 : Bournemouth forward Eli Junior Kroupi has received his first France call-up as a replacement for the injured Marcus Thuram, the French Football Federation (FFF) said on Tuesday. • Kroupi was the French second-tier top scorer in the 2024-25 season with 22 goals for Lorient, before joining Bournemouth. • The 20-year-old forward, who played five times for the France Under-21 team, scored 13 goals last season in his first Premier League campaign. • He has played only four matches this season in all competitions, as he recovered from a foot injury.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 10 : Toyota Motor said on Tuesday it will bring its ultra-compact mini KEI trucks to the US market for fleet customers starting in the second half of 2027 as part of a limited rollout after President Donald Trump encouraged the move. A third of the 3.7 million new cars sold in Japan last year were mini, or "kei", cars — tiny vehicles that are not produced by American automakers. The KEI-01, which has a 660 cc three-cylinder engine and four-wheel drive, will be assembled at Toyota's plant in Indiana. Toyota will add 50 jobs and invest $34 million in the project. The right-hand-drive trucks measure just over 11 feet (3.35 m) in length and under 5 feet in width with a maximum speed of 25 miles per hour (40 kph). Toyota said the vehicle is designed to comply with federal low-speed vehicle safety requirements and initial distribution will focus on fleet customers rather than retail sales. Toyota also said it is relaunching its Scion in the US.

Trump wanted kei cars in the United States but has said he wants them to be assembled domestically. Toyota said it may consider expanding availability to limited retail sales at a later date. Toyota said the kei trucks could be used by small business owners, delivery fleets, farmers and ranchers as well as cities, universities and corporate campuses.

item.description: [１０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１０日 ロイター] - ウクライナが１０月末以降、ロシアの製油所に対するドローン（無人機）攻撃を再開し、ロシアの石油精製能力が落ち込んでいる。業界関係者２人は、精製能力が約３割減少したとする推計を明らかにした。ロシアは軽油の輸出でトランプ米大統領と合意しており、製油所攻撃によりロシア国内の燃料不足への対応が一層困難になるとみられる。

トランプ氏がウクライナとロシア双方に「エネルギー停戦」を提唱したにもかかわらず、ウクライナは１０月末以降、ロシアの製油所への攻撃を強化。ロシア北西部レニングラード州の知事によると、今月９日未明には、キリシにあるロシア第２の規模の製油所が攻撃を受けた。

業界関係者や当局者によると、直近１週間で、ロシアの主要製油所３５カ所のうち９カ所で、攻撃により操業が中断した。関係者によると、ドローン攻撃を受けた製油所の定格処理能力は合計で日量約３０万トン（約２２０万バレル）。ロシア全体の一次精製能力は日量約９３万トンで、１０月末時点では、日量約７０万トン（約５００万バレル）の原油を処理していた。関係者は、原油処理量の実際の減少幅は、最大で日量２０万トンの可能性があると推定している。

ロシアのラブロフ外相はコメルサント紙で、エネルギー関連施設への攻撃停止を求めたトランプ氏の呼びかけをウクライナが無視していると主張。一方、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、製油所などへの攻撃はロシアによる攻撃に対応したものだと述べている。

Nov 10 : Mercor said on Tuesday it had raised $750 million in a funding round that valued the AI training startup at $20 billion. The Series D round drew participation from Benchmark, Felicis, Fundomo, Nvidia and funds managed by affiliates of Apollo, among others. Here are more details: • Investor enthusiasm for AI has fueled a sharp rise in private funding this year, creating a growing group of heavily capitalized startups carrying multibillion-dollar valuations

• Mercor, which began as an AI-powered hiring platform, now connects technology companies with subject-matter experts whose knowledge is used to train, test and improve AI models and agents • The San Francisco-based company said it will use the funding to help train and test AI agents on professional tasks • "Every job in the economy will need its own AI agents and every company will need a way to train and evaluate them on its own work," co-CEO Brendan Foody said • According to Crunchbase, AI-driven startups raised $102 billion, or 64 per cent of global venture capital, in the third quarter of 2026 • Mercor, which is backed by Jack Dorsey and venture capitalist Peter Thiel, was valued at about $10 billion after raising $350 million in October last year

item.title: 米国防長官、イラン戦争巡る弾劾は「茶番」 正副大統領とも擁護
item.description:
Phil Stewart
[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Phil Stewart

[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - ヘグセス米国防長官は１０日、イラン紛争を巡り、自身に対する弾劾に向けた動きについて、「茶番」で、敵対勢力の思惑に利用される「妨害行為だ」と非難した。

共和党のマッシー下院議員は９日、議会の承認なしにイランとの戦争を遂行したことや、職権乱用などの容疑を巡り、ヘグセス長官に対する８項目の弾劾訴追条項を提出した。

ヘグセス長官は５月以来となる国防総省での記者会見で、トランプ大統領に対する過去の弾劾は失敗に終わり、「トランプ氏はより強くなり、米国民によって再選された」と指摘。「今回もまた失敗に終わるだろう。トランプ大統領を支持することで、私がトランプ氏と同じ側になるのであれば、私は喜んでいつでもその立場を受け入れる」と語った。

弾劾に向けた動きは「愛国心ではない。破壊行為だ」と批判。「われわれの敵にプロパガンダ上の勝利を与えることになる」との認識を示した。

イランの戦争については「これら作戦全てを支持する。作戦を実行できたことを誇りに思っている」と述べた。

イラン戦争が、米中間選挙での共和党の敗因の一つだったというバンス副大統領の発言については、紛争から教訓を学ぶとしつつも、「イランが核兵器を保有しないことを確実にするという正当な理由に基づいて行われた」と擁護した。

マッシー下院議員はＸへの投稿で、下院が１０日に弾劾決議案に関する手続き上の動議について最初の採決を行うと明らかにした。

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、マッシー議員を非難した上で、ヘグセス氏の対応を「Aプラス、プラス、プラスの評価に値する」とし、同長官への支持を再表明した。

バンス米副大統領は公の場で戦争に疑問を呈し、共和党が中間選挙で大敗した原因だと指摘してきたが、１０日はヘグセス氏への支持を表明。Ｘに「これはイランの問題ではない。ピート（ヘグセス氏）が国防総省の官僚組織に立ち向かったことが問題にされている」と投稿した。

item.title: Nvidia Stock Plunges Despite President Trump Backs Huang in China Spy Storm
item.description: NVDA shares fell about 3% on Tuesday despite President Donald Trump voicing support for CEO Jensen Huang amid an internal company investigation involving allegations of Chinese espionage.Trump said ...
item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Nvidia Stock Plunges Despite President Trump Backs Huang in China Spy Storm

Nvidia Stock Plunges Despite President Trump Backs Huang in China Spy Storm Less than 1 min read

NVDA Nvidia NVDA shares fell about 3% on Tuesday despite President Donald Trump voicing support for CEO Jensen Huang amid an internal company investigation involving allegations of Chinese espionage. Trump said Monday that he had spoken with Huang and believed the executive was unaware of the alleged intelligence links of a woman connected to him. The president also confirmed that the FBI was examining the matter. Huang acknowledged the relationship in an email to employees Sunday and pledged to cooperate with Nvidia's investigation, according to media reports. The woman, identified as Alice Huang, is suspected by U.S. intelligence agencies of attempting to influence the chipmaker's position on restrictions governing advanced semiconductor exports to China. Elon Musk and investor Bill Ackman (Trades, Portfolio) have also publicly backed Huang, while Nvidia has maintained that it has no reason to believe company trade secrets or U.S. national security information were compromised. China has rejected the espionage claims, describing them as unfounded. The controversy has also drawn legal scrutiny. Nvidia and Huang were sued by shareholders in a proposed class-action case filed in California, with investors alleging that they were not informed about potential risks associated with the matter.

item.title: Dan Ives Says Microsoft Amazon and Meta Win Big as Data Center Slowdown Looms
item.description: Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives said a potential slowdown in U.S. data center construction could favor major cloud providers with operating capacity, according to a Monday research note.He cited midterm ...
item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Dan Ives Says Microsoft Amazon and Meta Win Big as Data Center Slowdown Looms

Dan Ives Says Microsoft Amazon and Meta Win Big as Data Center Slowdown Looms Less than 1 min read

SPCX TSLA AMZN Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives said a potential slowdown in U.S. data center construction could favor major cloud providers with operating capacity, according to a Monday research note. He cited midterm election results and Texas governor Gina Hinojosa's approach to data center development, where SpaceX SPCX and Tesla TSLA have large operations. Ives estimated that 10% to 30% of planned U.S. data centers may not be built over the next 18 months under a "Blue Wave" scenario. He said firms with available gigawatts and GPUs could become more valuable. The note named Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon AMZN , Alphabet (GOOGL), Meta Platforms (META), and in some cases Oracle (ORCL) as potential beneficiaries. Overall capital spending is still expected to reach $3 trillion to $4 trillion over the next few years, with Big Tech capex above $1 trillion next year, Ives said. A slower buildout could reduce capital raising by about 25% over the next year. Ives added that the AI revolution will continue, though at a slower rate, and political leaders will need to balance data center concerns with global AI competition.

item.title: Anthropic's potential mega IPO joins ranks of world's biggest stock market listings
item.description: Anthropic has kicked off its U.S. IPO roadshow, seeking to raise up to $64.4 billion by offering 825 million shares. This latest valuation stands at roughly $1.4 trillion, representing a drop from earlier estimations of $2 trillion. Notably, tech giants like Alphabet and Microsoft are set to invest $26 billion in a private placement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its hotly anticipated US initial public offering on Tuesday, bringing the Claude maker a step closer to a landmark debut that is set to test investor appetite for the rapidly growing AI industry.The listing would represent what is expected to be one of the largest debuts ever attempted, potentially reshaping benchmark indexes, investor flows and the broader narrative driving US equities.A GLANCE AT WORLD'S BIGGEST IPOsThe biggest IPOs globally, ranked by deal size:ANTHROPICThe filing confirmed Reuters reporting that Anthropic and some existing shareholders were seeking to raise up to $64.4 billion in its U.S. IPO, offering 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each and targeting a valuation of about $1.4 trillion.Investors had previously discussed a valuation of as much as $2 trillion, but expectations have since fallen amid Anthropic's hefty infrastructure commitments and volatility in AI-related stocks. Reuters previously reported that about $1.5 trillion was viewed as the high end of the range.Anthropic has also lined up $26 billion from some of the world's biggest technology companies in a private placement alongside the IPO, highlighting the increasingly intertwined financial ties underpinning the AI boom.Alphabet's Google, Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom, Micron Technology, Microsoft and TSMC have agreed to participate in the private placement at the IPO price.Details of the blockbuster offering were briefly circulated to banks before being retracted late on Monday, according to emails seen by Reuters.The IPO has already been pushed back from earlier plans, with Reuters previously reporting that marketing was expected to begin in mid-October at the earliest.Reuters has previously reported details of Anthropic's financial performance, growth trajectory and IPO plans.Anthropic, founded in 2021 by a team of researchers who left OpenAI after disagreements over governance and AI safety,raised $65 billion at a post-money valuation of $965 billion in late May.OPENAIOpenAI, which operates AI chatbot ChatGPT, revealed in June that it had confidentially filed for a US IPO.The company will not go public in 2026, CEO Sam Altman had said in September, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence that render unacceptable even a 10% risk that AI could cause human extinction by decade's end.OpenAI President Greg Brockman last week said the company now generates the majority of its revenue from enterprise sales and he believes it will be ready to go public in 2027.The company has been racing to ramp up fundraising, Reuters has reported, in order to capitalize on its recent growth after delaying its IPO plans.OpenAI has closed on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion, Reuters reported last week.In May, OpenAI fended off an existential court challenge from Elon Musk, simplifying the path for it to proceed with a stock market listing. We have not decided on timing yet; it may be a while because there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company. But it's a complicated set of tradeoffs and this gives us the option to go public sooner if that ends up being best, OpenAI had said in June.SPACEXElon Musk's rocket and satellite maker SpaceX made a historic Nasdaq debut in June, raising a record $75 billion and eclipsing Saudi Aramco's 2019 listing to become the world's largest IPO.The offering broke with Wall Street convention by setting the price before the investor roadshow, which is typically used to gauge demand and establish a price range. Its proceeds were more than double those of Saudi Aramco;s IPO.SpaceX shares ended their first trading day at $160.95, valuing the company at $2.1 trillion. The stock has since lost momentum, closing at $142.07 on November 9, but remained above its $135 IPO price.

item.title: 米12月0.5％利上げ確率15％に、10月ＣＰＩ予想上回る
item.description: [１０日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回り、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米12月0.5％利上げ確率15％に、10月ＣＰＩ予想上回る 11/10 23:44 配信

２０１５年１２月撮影　REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque（ロイター） [１０日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回り、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者が利上げペース加速の可能性に言及したことを受け、 金融市場ではＦＲＢが１２月の会合で０．５％ポイントの利上げに踏み切るとの観測が浮上した。

現在、市場では１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定されるとの見方はほぼ完全に織り込まれている。ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、同ＦＯＭＣで０．５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は、午前半ばの時点で１５％近くに上昇した。

労働省発表の１０月のＣＰＩは前月比０．４％上昇。伸びはロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の０．３％を上回った。９月は０．６％上昇していた。変動の大きい食品とエネルギーを除くコアＣＰＩは前月比０．３％上昇。エコノミスト予想は０．２％上昇だった。

ＦＲＢ当局者はこれまでに、ＣＰＩが予想以上に強ければ一段と積極的な金融引き締めを支持する考えを示している。

ウォラー理事は１０日、米国の１０月のインフレ率が鈍化したとしてもＦＲＢは１２月の会合で利上げを支持する考えを示し、物価情勢が悪化した場合は０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げを検討する必要があると述べた。

米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁は同日、インフレを抑制するにはＦＲＢが少なくともあと２回、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施する必要があるとし、幅広い物価上昇圧力が経済に定着するのを防ぐため、速やかに行動する必要があるかもしれないとの考えを示した。

インフレーション・インサイツのオマイル・シャリフ社長はＣＰＩ発表後、「今回の統計には、根強いインフレリスクや、物価上昇圧力を抑えるためにＦＲＢが追加利上げを迫られることへの懸念を和らげる材料はほとんどなかった」と記した。

シャリフ氏は、今回のＣＰＩを踏まえると、１０月のコア個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前月比０．３４％上昇する見通しだとした。年率換算では４％を超え、前月から加速することになる。ＦＲＢはＰＣＥ価格指数に基づいて２％のインフレ目標を設定しているが、物価動向を把握する上ではコア指数の方が適切と見ている。

ロイター 関連リンク コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も アングル：ＦＯＭＣで利上げほぼ確実、ウォーシュ氏の政策説明も不可避か コラム：ＦＯＭＣと日銀会合、金融政策ウイークの注目点＝植野大作氏 11/11(水) 2:56 最終更新 ロイター

item.description: [パリ １０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ　１０日　ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は１０日、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の同盟国に対し、米国による対イラン経済制裁や海上封鎖は効果を上げており、トランプ大統領がイランに対する大規模な軍事作戦を実施する必要はないと説明したと明らかにした。

ルビオ長官はＧ７外相会合が開かれているパリで記者団に対し、米国が科した制裁によるイラン経済への打撃は時間の経過とともに拡大しており、米国には依然として「真の合意」に向けて協議する用意があると語った。

長官は「イランが現在受けている経済的苦痛は前例のない規模で、日々深刻化している」と強調。「経済的な手段や圧力によって同じ目的を達成できるのであれば、軍事攻撃を行う必要はない。それは行き詰まりではない」と述べた。また、「イランは今日ほど世界市場でエネルギーを販売できない状況に直面したことはかつてなかった」と語った。

複数のＧ７外交官によると、ルビオ長官は米国がイランに対し「壊滅的な」経済的代償を課し続ける考えを示したほか、イラン当局者を「狂人」と表現したという。

トランプ大統領は９日、イランへの新たな軍事攻撃を当面見送る方針を示した。

関係筋によると、トランプ大統領の側近の間では、ベセント財務長官やミラー大統領首席補佐官が軍事攻撃よりも経済的圧力を重視している。また、バンス副大統領はイランとの合意を望んでいるものの、トランプ大統領は現時点で合意成立は困難とみているという。

TSMC to invest up to $1 billion in Anthropic, OpenAI

FAST

TAIPEI, Nov 10 : TSMC plans to invest up to $1 billion across leading AI developers Anthropic and OpenAI, highlighting the Taiwanese chipmaker's confidence in long-term demand for the technology even as concerns grow about soaring AI spending. The company is positioning itself to benefit not only from supplying AI infrastructure, but also from owning stakes in some of the industry's most influential developers. TSMC's board approved on Tuesday an investment of up to $500 million to acquire shares in Anthropic at its initial public offering price, and an investment of up to $500 million to acquire preferred stock in OpenAI. The move comes after Anthropic on Tuesday priced its initial public offering at $70 to $78 per share, seeking a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in what would be one of the largest stock market debuts on record.

The Claude maker is also raising $26 billion through a separate private placement backed by investors, including Alphabet's Google, Nvidia, AMD and Microsoft. TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker and a critical supplier to leading AI firms, including Nvidia, whose pricey graphics processors underpin many of today's AI models. Last month, TSMC reported a sixth consecutive quarter of record profit and said demand for AI-related chips remained "extremely robust," even as it adopted a cautious outlook for 2027. The company expects full-year 2026 revenue growth of about 44 per cent and said demand continues to outstrip its manufacturing capacity. TSMC is also expanding production, including a $265 billion investment in manufacturing facilities in Arizona and an evaluation of potential projects in Texas.

Nov 10 : Amazon's Ring on Tuesday launched a new robotics business with two autonomous security products, a flying indoor camera for homes and a roving security robot designed for businesses, as the company expands beyond its established lineup of home-security devices. • Both devices - Ring Drone and Ring Rover - use Ring's AI Pilot system, which combines cameras, vision models, on-device sensors and cloud processing to map spaces, identify potential patrol points and navigate around obstacles, Amazon said • The launch marks an expansion of Ring's security business, which began with video doorbells and has grown into a broader network of connected cameras, sensors and alarms. • The company said the new robots are designed to work with the existing devices through the Ring app

item.title: Anthropic eyes $1.4 trillion valuation in blockbuster IPO, targets up to $90.4 billion in fundraising
item.description: Anthropic is targeting a fully diluted $1.4 trillion valuation through its proposed IPO, seeking up to $64.35 billion. Combined with a $26 billion private placement, fundraising could reach $90.4 billion amid rising infrastructure costs and competition.
item.dc:creator: Kumar Gaurav
item.content:encoded: Anthropic is targeting a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in its proposed initial public offering (IPO), setting the stage for one of the largest stock market listings as the artificial intelligence company prepares to tap public investors. The Claude maker has launched its IPO roadshow, offering 825 million shares in a price band of $70-78 apiece. The company is seeking to raise up to $64.35 billion through the public offering, according to its regulatory filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).The proposed issue comprises 801.35 million shares being issued by Anthropic and another 23.65 million shares offered by existing shareholders. At the upper end of the price band, the company could generate gross proceeds of approximately $62.51 billion from its primary share sale, before expenses, according to reports.Anthropic is also looking to raise an additional $26 billion through a separate private placement involving cornerstone investors, including Alphabet's Google, Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD). Combined, the IPO and private placement could take the total fundraising to as much as $90.4 billion.The targeted $1.4 trillion valuation is calculated on a fully diluted basis, factoring in securities such as stock options and restricted shares. At the top end of the IPO price range, Anthropic's market capitalisation would be approximately $1 trillion on a non-diluted basis, Reuters reported.The valuation target, however, is lower than the $2 trillion figure that some investors had previously discussed. Expectations have moderated amid the company's sizeable infrastructure commitments and volatility in AI-related stocks.ALSO READ: Anthropic's IPO: A close look at AI frontrunner's rapid growth, spiraling costsAI ambitions meet mounting infrastructure costsAnthropic's proposed listing comes at a time when investors are increasingly scrutinising the economics of artificial intelligence, particularly the enormous computing investments required to develop, train and operate advanced AI models.The company has nearly $900 billion in computing commitments with infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Alphabet's Google. These commitments highlight the scale of resources required to sustain its expansion and the importance of securing future computing capacity.Despite the substantial infrastructure requirements, Anthropic has reported rapid revenue growth, supported by increasing demand for its Claude family of AI models.According to its IPO filing, the company's run-rate revenue stood at approximately $81 billion as of October 31, up from the previous month. Revenue increased 47% sequentially to $16.96 billion in the third quarter, although the pace of growth moderated from the 144% increase recorded in the preceding quarter.Anthropic attributed the expansion to growing adoption of Claude, including specialised products designed for industries such as healthcare, financial services and legal services.However, the company remains loss-making, reflecting the significant expenditure involved in developing and scaling artificial intelligence systems.IPO document highlights competition, AI safety risksAnthropic's regulatory filing has also laid out several risks that could affect its business, ranging from intensifying competition to the challenges of ensuring the safe deployment of increasingly capable AI systems.The company warned that competitors could gain an advantage by developing AI models at a faster pace. It also flagged the risk that advances in artificial intelligence could outstrip its ability to implement adequate safety and security measures.Regulatory hurdles and increased government oversight could pose further challenges, particularly as Anthropic expands the infrastructure required to support its operations.The disclosures come amid growing concerns about AI agents operating beyond their intended environments and the potential misuse of increasingly sophisticated AI tools to breach protected networks.IPO could set new fundraising benchmarkAnthropic's proposed offering could rank among the largest IPOs in market history, following SpaceX's $75 billion stock market debut in June at a valuation of nearly $1.75 trillion. The figure excludes additional shares purchased by underwriters through the greenshoe option.The proposed listing has attracted interest from several major technology companies and investors. Apart from Google, Nvidia and AMD, broader investment commitments include companies such as Broadcom, Micron Technology, Microsoft and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC).Certain members of Anthropic's board and entities affiliated with them have also expressed interest in purchasing up to $303 million worth of shares in the offering.Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ANT.The offering will be made through a prospectus, with preliminary copies available through Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, among the underwriters managing the transaction.The registration statement covering the securities has been filed with the SEC but has not yet become effective.Disclosure: This article has been written by Kumar Gaurav, who is not a Sebi-registered Research Analyst or an Investment Adviser. Gaurav and their ‘relative(s)’ (as defined under Section 2(77) of the Companies Act, 2013) do not hold any financial interest in the companies mentioned in this article as of the date of publication. The views/recommendations mentioned in this article, wherever applicable, are those of the respective Sebi-registered Research Analyst/brokerage and have been reproduced/reported with due attribution. They should not be construed as the views or recommendations of The Economic Times Digital or the journalist. Readers are advised to consider the original research report and make their investment decisions based on their own assessment. Brokerage disclaimers here

SANTIAGO, Nov 10 (Reuters) – Truck drivers across Chile staged strikes and blockades on Tuesday to protest sustained fuel price increases linked to global geopolitical volatility, disrupting traffic along the country’s key north-south highway and access to ports including Iquique.

The stoppage was called by Chile’s ‘Confederacion de Transportistas Fuerza del Norte’ and the ‘No+TAG’ movement, which expected to gather around 4,000 truckers, though the sector’s two largest associations declined to join.

• Protesters are demanding government measures to contain fuel prices, changes to the MEPCO fuel-price stabilization mechanism, and modifications to the tax burden on truckers

Show Full Article

• The government said on Monday it would seek to use fiscal savings to support MEPCO

• It also plans to send a bill to prevent weekly fuel price increases of more than 20 pesos ($0.02) per liter

• A cruise ship canceled a planned stop in Iquique due to the potential impact of protests, according to Diario Financiero newspaper

($1 = 967.0000 Chilean pesos)

(Reporting by Fabian Cambero; writing by Aida Pelaez-Fernandez)

item.title: 米10月ＣＰＩ、予想上回る前月比0.4％上昇 12月利上げ観測強まる
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（Ｃ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月ＣＰＩ、予想上回る前月比0.4％上昇　12月利上げ観測強まる 11/10 22:54 配信

８月２６日、米ニューヨーク州ニューヨーク市で撮影　REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比０．４％上昇した。食品や住居費の上昇を背景に市場予想（０．３％）を上回り、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１２月の会合で利上げに向けた方針を維持するとみられる。

９月は０．６％上昇だった。０．４％を超える伸びは３カ月連続となる。

変動の大きい食品とエネルギーを除くコアＣＰＩは前月比０．３％上昇した。３カ月連続で同じ上昇率となり、市場予想の０．２％上昇を上回った。

昨年１０月は連邦政府機関の閉鎖により消費者物価データが収集されなかったため、労働省は前年比での変化率は公表しなかった。９月の前年比は、総合指数が３．７％上昇、コア指数が２．６％上昇だった。

一部のエコノミストは、データが得られている昨年９月と１１月の指数平均のほか、独立情報源から算出した補間値を利用して１０月の総合指数の前年比の変化率を推計。こうして算出された推計値によると、１０月の総合指数の前年比上昇率は３．９─４．０％だった可能性がある。

＜１２月０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げ観測も浮上＞

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「消費者のインフレの悪夢は続いており、改善の兆しは見られない」とし、「ＦＲＢ当局者は、インフレの火消しを望むなら、より強力な消火ホースを用意する必要があるだろう」と述べた。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ証券のエコノミスト、スティーブン・ジュノー氏は「ＦＲＢはインフレ対応で後手に回りつつあり、１０月の会合で決定した金利据え置きは政策ミスだった可能性がある」と指摘。「ＦＲＢは来年は、３月ではなく１月にも追加利上げを迫られるリスクが高まっている」と述べた。

ウォラーＦＲＢ理事はこの日のＣＰＩ発表前、少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを支持し、インフレ状況が悪化すれば０．５％ポイントの利上げも検討すべきとの見解を示していた。

１０月のＣＰＩの伸びが予想を上回り、ＦＲＢ当局者が利上げペース加速の可能性に言及したことを受け、ＦＲＢは１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げに踏み切るとの観測が金融市場で浮上している。ただ、０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定されるとの見方がなお優勢で、ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによるとその確率は約８９％となっている。

＜ガソリン１．０％上昇、ディーゼル２．７％上昇＞

１０月の住居費（家賃・ホテルなどの宿泊料含む）は前月比０．３％上昇し、全体のＣＰＩ上昇分の３割超を占めた。９月も０．４％上昇していた。

食品は前月比０．５％上昇。過去３カ月はほぼ横ばい状態が続いていた。

スーパーマーケットでの食品価格は０．４％上昇。牛肉は０．９％、卵は０．６％、果物・野菜は０．６％、乳製品は０．６％、スナック菓子は１％それぞれ上昇した。

スーパーマーケットでの食品価格上昇は、ディーゼル燃料価格の上昇を反映している可能性がある。サンタンデールＵＳキャピタル・マーケッツのチーフ米国エコノミスト、スティーブン・スタンリー氏は「輸送コスト上昇の食料品価格への転嫁が始まった可能性がある」とし、「こうした動きが実際に起きている場合、幅広い商品に共通して見られる現象になる可能性がある」と述べた。

外食費は０．５％上昇、レストラン（フルサービス）も０．７％上昇した。

ガソリンは１．０％上昇した。９月の９．１％急騰からは鈍化した。ディーゼルは前月の１１．９％上昇に続き、２．７％上昇した。イラン戦争を受けて原油価格が上昇しているほか、トランプ政権が昨年導入した輸入関税も生活費の押し上げ要因となっている。高インフレは先週の米中間選挙で共和党が大敗した一因となった。

持ち家の帰属家賃は前月比０．３％上昇し、コアＣＰＩを押し上げた。

ホテル・モーテル料金は０．６％、航空運賃は０．４％、娯楽は０．８％、自動車保険料は０．７％、家具・家庭用品は０．７％それぞれ上昇した。

Germany's Helsing to unveil AI-based military software as a rival to Palantir

FILE PHOTO: A delegate walks past a display showing an autonomous uncrewed combat aerial vehicle by Helsing at the Berlin Security Conference, a congress on European Security and Defence in Berlin, Germany, November 3, 2026. REUTERS/Annegret Hilse/File Photo

FAST

BERLIN, Nov 10 : German defence firm Helsing will present new artificial intelligence-based military targeting software on Wednesday, seeking to benefit from growing concerns among European governments about relying on US companies such as Palantir. After President Donald Trump's repeated threats to quit NATO, concerns over dependence on Washington and data sovereignty have fuelled resistance against US data analytics and defence software firm Palantir in parts of Europe. The company makes the best-known military AI system of its kind, the Maven Smart System, which has been deployed by the US, NATO commands and several NATO members. In the invitation to the Berlin presentation of its system, Helsing said it was "crucial that we be able to conduct precise reconnaissance, make the right decisions in the face of uncertainty, and act with precision on the battlefield, with autonomy and without dependencies: from Europe and for Europe".

The war in Ukraine has shown the value of AI tools in dramatically speeding up battlefield decision-making by rapidly processing and interpreting vast streams of data generated by drones, satellites and other sensors. PALANTIR INSISTS CUSTOMERS ARE IN FULL CONTROL Palantir has insisted its customers are in full operational control of the software that they buy from the company and that it does not have a "kill switch" to deactivate it remotely. Concerns over dependence on the US were exacerbated last month after speed restrictions for Ukraine's Starlink terminals hampered Kyiv's efforts to intercept Russian drones and forced some operations to be cancelled. In June, the Trump administration moved to block non-US residents from Anthropic's most advanced models, Mythos and Fable, on national security grounds, prompting the AI company to abruptly suspend access to the models globally. The ban was lifted later the same month, but European lawmakers still warn the episode showed that the US holds a "kill switch" over essential technologies that it is more than willing to use. The German military has made clear that, for now at least, it will not buy Palantir's Maven for its forces. The country is aiming to deploy its own AI-powered system from 2027, with full implementation expected in 2028.

Source: Reuters

item.description: MUNICH, Nov 10 : Dutch chipmaker Nexperia is "totally oversubscribed" as suppliers divert manufacturing capacity toward fast-growing AI data centres and away from the mature chips used in cars and industrial equipment, interim CEO Stefan Tilger told Reuters at the Electronica trade fair in Munich on Tuesday.T

Chipmakers warn AI demand is creating bottlenecks in automotive supply chain

Infineon CEO Jochen Hanebeck, STMicroelectronics CEO Jean-Marc Chery, and NXP CEO Rafael Sotomayor speak at a conference in Munich, Germany, November 9, 2026. Picture taken with a mobile phone. REUTERS/Nathan Vifflin

FAST

MUNICH, Nov 10 : Dutch chipmaker Nexperia is "totally oversubscribed" as suppliers divert manufacturing capacity toward fast-growing AI data centres and away from the mature chips used in cars and industrial equipment, interim CEO Stefan Tilger told Reuters at the Electronica trade fair in Munich on Tuesday. Tilger said some competitors had shifted capacity away from the commodity semiconductors supplied by Nexperia, creating bottlenecks in parts of the automotive supply chain. "The automotive industry is suffering at the moment quite heavily," he said in an interview. STMicroelectronics CEO Jean-Marc Chery warned on Monday that foundries and chip-packaging companies were increasingly shifting resources away from products used in automotive and industrial applications.

"We see many bottlenecks," Chery said at a CEO panel ahead of the conference on Monday. The comments add to evidence that the AI investment boom is creating bottlenecks elsewhere in the semiconductor supply chain, as manufacturers prioritise higher-margin products linked to data centres and artificial intelligence. Some foundries and assembly and packaging firms that previously served a broad range of customers "are disengaging ... from mainstream technology", he said. Tilger said demand from AI data centres and robotics was absorbing capacity, while investment in the mature technologies used for diodes, transistors and other basic components had lagged for years. Nexperia specialises in high-volume, low-cost semiconductors used primarily in vehicles and industrial equipment. Unlike larger rivals such as STMicroelectronics, it has a narrower product range focused on mature-node components. Chery said ST's own manufacturing footprint offered some protection from supply constraints. "We control a part of our future with our CapEx and our manufacturing," he said.

Source: Reuters

item.description: NEW YORK, Nov 10 : Banks worldwide are trying to curb the soaring cost of AI agents as spending on the tokens that power them could easily reach 20 per cent of total labor costs, according to McKinsey's Global Banking Annual Review.Responsibility for controlling AI-related spending has shifted to new teams th

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 10 : Banks worldwide are trying to curb the soaring cost of AI agents as spending on the tokens that power them could easily reach 20 per cent of total labor costs, according to McKinsey's Global Banking Annual Review. Responsibility for controlling AI-related spending has shifted to new teams that some banks call AI FinOps. Initially, banks sought to rein in costs with systems that directed employees to different AI models based on the complexity of their queries. "But those models are ineffective when AI agents are working, because they communicate with each other and tokens quickly add up," said Vik Sohoni, a senior partner at McKinsey and one of the report's authors, in an interview with Reuters. As a result, banks are becoming more selective about where they deploy agentic AI, focusing on areas with the strongest expected returns. Productivity-related savings are relatively easy to measure, but banks are increasingly looking at AI-driven revenue growth to determine where higher spending is justified, Sohoni said.

Customers are adopting AI much faster than previous technologies, according to the report. McKinsey expects AI agents to become widely used within three years, compared with the 5 to 10 years it took mobile internet to gain broad adoption. A McKinsey survey of 46,000 retail banking customers worldwide found that most already use AI to compare banking services, find higher-yield savings accounts and refinance or consolidate debt. Among AI users, 72 per cent said they would allow a banking agent to carry out one financial task, although they would cap autonomous approvals at $500. Meta's Muse agent was downloaded 5 million times in the US during its first 22 days after launch. While AI agents could help banks boost revenue and cut costs, they could also pressure profits by shifting deposits from non-interest-bearing accounts into higher-yielding accounts. So far, that impact has been limited because most banks block external AI agents from authorizing transactions within their systems.

Source: Reuters

MOSCOW, Nov 10 : Russian technology giant Yandex has restored 97.16 per cent of customer data in its Yandex Cloud service after drone attacks hit its infrastructure in October, while the rest is permanently lost, the company said on Tuesday. "The remaining 2.84 per cent cannot be recovered due to critical damage to equipment and the absence of backups on the platform by customers," the company said in its statement. Three Yandex data centres were damaged in Ukrainian drone strikes in early October, causing disruptions to infrastructure and services, primarily Yandex Cloud. The company previously said that supercomputers located in two of the data centres were not damaged and had been moved to other locations.

item.title: アンソロピックＩＰＯ、評価額1.4兆ドルに 最大644億ドル調達
item.description:
Echo Wang
[１０日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックによる新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）での調...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックＩＰＯ、評価額1.4兆ドルに　最大644億ドル調達 11/10 21:35 配信

アンソロピックのロゴ REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration（ロイター） Echo Wang

[１０日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックによる新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）での調達額は最大６４４億ドルとなる見通しだ。評価額は最大１兆４０００億ドルで、一部投資家の期待をやや下回る水準となる。 ＡＩブームに対する米金融市場の信頼を測る重要な試金石となる。

１０日の規制当局への届出書で明らかになった。

売り出し株数は８億２５００万株で、最大６４４億ドルの調達を目指す。公開価格の上限は１株７８ドル。

アンソロピックは別途、アルファベット傘下のグーグル、エヌビディア、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）などの中核投資家を対象とした私募で２６０億ドルを調達する。

中核投資家にはブロードコム、マイクロン・テクノロジー、マイクロソフト、台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）も含まれ、これらの投資家からの出資を合わせた調達総額は最大９０４億ドルとなる。

同社は歴史的規模の株式売り出しに向け投資家向け説明会（ロードショー）を開始する。

仮条件の上限では、ストックオプションや譲渡制限付き株式などを含む完全希薄化ベースでの評価額は約１兆４０００億ドルとなる。これらの証券を除く非希薄化ベースでは、時価総額は約１兆ドルとなる。

ロイターが確認した電子メールによると、この大型案件の詳細は投資銀行に一時共有されたものの、９日遅くに撤回された。

暫定的な条件では、アンソロピックは約８億６７００万株を１株最大８０ドルで売り出し、既存株主の売り出し分を含め最大６９３億ドルを調達する計画だった。

最終的にＳＥＣへ提出された目論見書は異なる条件となっており、アンソロピックは価格帯を引き下げ、調達額を減らす方針を示した。

投資家はかつて最大２兆ドルの評価額を視野に入れていたが、巨額のインフラ投資契約や最近のＡＩ関連株の変動を受けて期待は後退し、１兆５０００億ドルが上限と見なされるようになっていた。

スイスクオート銀行（ジュネーブ）のシニアアナリスト、イペク・オズカルデシュカヤ氏は「２兆ドルの評価額から現在の水準への変化は、売上高の成長だけに着目する姿勢から、それを維持するために必要な巨額の資金拠出の確約や支出へと焦点が移ったことを反映している」と語った。

２６年後半に入り、ＡＩブームは真価を問われている。金利が高止まりする中、巨額の支出や増大する借り入れコストに見合うリターンが得られるか市場は疑問を抱いている。

投資サイクルの持続性への懸念も高まっている。資金が循環する形の取引やインフラの供給過剰リスク、企業がＡＩ投資をどれだけ早く収益につなげられるかが問題だ。

ただ、アンソロピックはこれまでのところ、急速に普及したＡＩモデル「クロード」を中心に、製品への需要が急増していることが追い風となり、成長を続けている。

提出書類では「奇跡の時代をもたらす」という構想を掲げる一方で人類存亡のリスクも警告。ＡＩブームの核心にある並外れた可能性と深い不確実性が浮き彫りになった。

item.content:encoded:

Anthropic's $1.4 trillion IPO bid sets up high-stakes test for AI market

Anthropic logo in this illustration taken November 6, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

10 Nov 2026 08:17PM (Updated: 10 Nov 2026 09:42PM)

FAST

Nov 10 : Anthropic's blockbuster IPO is set to give the company a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, marking a defining test of investor confidence in the AI boom it helped ignite. Reuters exclusively reported on Tuesday that Anthropic and some of its investors aim to sell shares in an indicative price band of between $70 and $78 per share. The company is launching the roadshow for a historic share sale that is expected to set a benchmark for the sector, following years of hype that fueled a massive influx of capital into AI companies. COMMENTS:

ART HOGAN, CHIEF MARKET STRATEGIST AT B RILEY WEALTH, NEW YORK "Anthropic is very well anticipated and the more we learn about it, the more we'll likely see it as a positive catalyst getting done this year. You just have to look at their revenue growth and what they've been able to do over the course of the last year. So the story is all about their revenue growth, very much like the SpaceX IPO was. I think the fact that it will be now publicly traded, we'll have more information on a regular basis about how they're actually doing and you know, how long it will take to turn that revenue growth into earnings growth." MICHAEL FIELD, CHIEF EQUITY STRATEGIST, MORNINGSTAR, AMSTERDAM "It's an attractive offering, ultimately. I think that's going to be reflected in investor demand. Maybe the timing has actually worked out pretty okay for this. The valuation that they were looking for has fallen. Initially, we're talking $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion, and then $1 trillion to $1.5 trillion, and now it's just over $1 trillion." A key number for them is that trillion figure. If they couldn't get it away for that, then they might hold off. But ultimately, in their mind, if they can get the first batch off at a trillion, then that's enough for them to get the ball rolling on this." PATRICK ARMSTRONG, CHIEF INVESTMENT OFFICER, PLURIMI WEALTH, LONDON "Anthropic has swung back to a loss, and it is not going public in as hot a market as it would have been if it had done so in the summer. I do not think the price it gets, or the implied market value, will drive the AI trade. But if it has a very disappointing IPO, that would take further wind out of the sails of the AI market. You have hyperscalers with negative free cash flow, and data-center demand is being questioned because of politics." Valuation for companies like this is more art than science. There are comparison points such as SpaceX, which has a significant AI component, and the hyperscalers, which have embedded AI and cloud-computing businesses. But it is still a leap of faith, because the company is years away from meaningful free cash flow, even in more optimistic scenarios." LUKAS MUEHLBAUER, ASSOCIATE, IPOX SCHUSTER, EDINBURGH "The latest growth figures justify taking a trillion-dollar valuation seriously, however, being the first major pure-play AI lab to go public, there aren't really any direct peers to compare against. The most important factor in valuing Anthropic is the cash it can ultimately generate from customers after funding model development and computing infrastructure. The key questions are how durable customer spending is and whether the economics of providing inference improve over time. Customer retention and the spending required to maintain a technological lead are particularly important." FIONA CINCOTTA, SENIOR MARKET ANALYST, CITY INDEX, LONDON "It's a little bit lower than an initial expectation around the 69 billion that was sent out earlier this morning, but that was then considered inaccurate. And I think given the volatility, concerns towards AI that we've seen in sort of particularly last week. This is actually fairly bullish and it's showing that they are still sort of upbeat about the outlook as far as AI is concerned and that obviously that they think that the demand is going to be there." IPEK OZKARDESKAYA, SENIOR ANALYST AT SWISSQUOTE BANK, GENEVA, SWITZERLAND "What we are seeing is essentially a reassessment of Anthropic's value in a more challenging AI environment. The company continues to post impressive growth, but investors are increasingly focused on the cost of generating that growth. The shift from a $2 trillion valuation to today's level reflects a change in focus from revenue growth alone to the significant financial commitments and spending required to sustain it." The timing of the IPO is notable because investors have become much more focused on the costs of the AI buildout than they were over the past few years. Political and regulatory uncertainties, along with a higher interest-rate environment, have also raised questions about future AI spending. As a result, many investors see Anthropic's IPO as an important test of appetite for AI-related investments." MICHAEL BAKER, HEAD OF UK PREMIUM CLIENTS AT CAPITAL.COM, LONDON "You've got to build a sustainable client base that is willing to pay those sizeable bills, both on the consumer side and among businesses, that's what Anthropic will have to sustain. At the same time, it has to keep up with the costs of chips and data centers while continuing to offer competitive models and outperform major Chinese rivals." It's a huge valuation, and I think it will take a lot to convince investors that it represents a fair price."

Source: Reuters

item.title: US House Republicans choose Jim Jordan as their next party leader
item.description: House Republicans chose Jim Jordan on Tuesday to lead them in opposition to a Democratic-controlled Congress, according to a person familiar with the matter, putting a combative Donald Trump ally at ...
item.content:encoded:
US House Republicans choose Jim Jordan as their next party leader Reuters | Updated: 11-11-2026 01:36 IST | Created: 11-11-2026 01:36 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

House Republicans chose Jim Jordan on Tuesday to lead them in opposition to a Democratic-controlled Congress, according to a person familiar with the matter, putting a combative Donald Trump ally at the forefront of the party’s fight to defend the US president’s agenda during his final two years in office. A secret ballot held behind closed doors elevated the Ohio Republican and House Judiciary Committee chairman to the minority leadership post a week after Democrats swept to victory in last Tuesday's midterm elections, winning sizable majorities in both the House and Senate. House Speaker Mike Johnson opted not to stand for the leadership position. Across the Capitol, Senate Republicans met behind closed doors to decide whether to push forward with internal elections that were expected to retain US Senator John Thune, a South Dakota Republican, as the party leader or opt for a delay that could allow a challenger to emerge. The House and Senate leadership elections will help determine what role Republicans intend to play as the minority party in Congress during the final two years of Trump's presidency. Democrats will need Republican support to move major initiatives in the 100-member Senate, where the filibuster rule requires 60 votes for most legislation. Their majorities in both chambers also fall well short of the two-thirds votes needed to override presidential vetoes. After the midterm elections, Thune vowed that Republicans would work with Trump to block "Democrat extremism" and work against any attempt by Democrats to unwind Republican achievements including border security and judicial appointments. Jordan, 62, was first elected in 2006 to represent a deeply conservative rural district in northern Ohio and was a founder of the House Freedom Caucus, a group that former Republican Speaker John Boehner labeled "legislative terrorists." Before entering politics, Jordan honed his pugilistic style during a career as a high school and university champion wrestler, and later as a wrestling coach at Ohio State University. That past threatened his political career in 2018 when former students accused him of turning a blind eye to rampant sexual abuse of college wrestlers by the wrestling team's doctor, when Jordan was an assistant coach. Jordan denied all allegations, and a university investigation found no hard evidence that he knew of the abuse. But former wrestlers said the doctor's abuse was well-known and the report itself found that students had complained about the doctor's voyeurism in front of coaching staff. Jordan has often referred to his wrestling background in terms of his reputation as a fighter in Congress. He is known for his aggressive style of questioning in committee hearings. "I look at it like a wrestling match," Jordan told the New York Times in an April 2023 interview, explaining how he prepares for hearings. "I'm going to try to get as ready as I can. You can't just wing it."

item.description: A senior US Army soldier was arrested in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence, British police said on Tuesday, after the US removed aircraft from British military bases over a ...
item.content:encoded:
US Army member arrested in UK for suspected 'espionage' for Russia Reuters | Updated: 11-11-2026 01:30 IST | Created: 11-11-2026 01:30 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

A senior US Army soldier was arrested in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence, British police said on Tuesday, after the US removed aircraft from British military bases over a separate apparent threat from Iran. FBI Director Kash Patel said the arrest of the 41-year-old man related to "allegations of espionage, which is of the utmost concern to the United States and our allies." Brigadier General Sean Stinchon, the commanding general of US Army Counterintelligence Command, added: "The alleged conduct of a senior soldier, entrusted with sensitive information, is a sobering reminder that insider threats are real and persistent." The arrest, which took place near the city of Gloucester, west England, on Tuesday "is not linked to any other ongoing Counter Terrorism Policing investigations", British police said. But it occurred the day after the US removed refuelling aircraft from a British airbase in the second such apparent evacuation in three months. Planes left the Royal Air Force base in Mildenhall, eastern England on Monday which, according to the Wall Street Journal, was prompted by a threat from Iran. The US in September withdrew bombers that had been used to strike Iran from RAF Fairford on security grounds over an incident police have linked to Iran, which has denied any links to attacks or incidents in Britain. The US Army soldier arrested on Tuesday was detained on suspicion of offences under sections 1 and 3 of the National Security Act, which relate to obtaining or disclosing protected information and assisting a foreign intelligence service. Police said the country to which the allegations relate is Russia.
